title: Composed supervisory control: Voted permissive with qualified bypass and diagnostics -> Toggle output on qualified rising edge

outputs.name: A_Degraded
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Run uses disagreement or bypass

outputs.name: A_Blocked
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Selected request cannot run

outputs.name: B_AcceptedPulse
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Qualified edge accepted this scan

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: The selected request shall be A_AutoRequest in automatic mode and A_ManualRequest otherwise.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Without bypass, A_RunPermit requires A_SafetyOK and at least two TRUE channels.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Bypass may latch only in manual mode when A_BypassRequest, A_BypassPermit, A_SafetyOK, and at least one channel are TRUE.
requirements.property: G(rose(A_BypassActive) -> (!A_AutoMode AND A_BypassRequest AND A_BypassPermit AND A_SafetyOK AND any_channel))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset may clear A_BypassActive only when neither automatic nor manual request is active.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Degraded shall identify a permitted run with channel disagreement or active bypass; A_Blocked shall identify a selected request without A_RunPermit.
requirements.property: G(A_Degraded = (A_RunPermit AND ((!unanimous_channels) OR A_BypassActive))) AND G(A_Blocked = (selected_request AND !A_RunPermit))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_State and suppress B_AcceptedPulse with highest priority.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A rising B_Button edge while B_Enable is TRUE shall invert B_State exactly once.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_AcceptedPulse = (B_Enable AND rose(B_Button) AND !B_Reset)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Holding B_Button TRUE shall not repeatedly toggle B_State.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Button AND prev(B_Button) AND !B_Reset) -> (B_State = prev(B_State))))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_RunPermit shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_State AND NOT B_AcceptedPulse)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_State AND NOT B_AcceptedPulse))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

composition.runtime_design: one stateful subsystem plus one stateless Boolean subsystem

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
